name: sol9-native-atom-evidence
goal: Qualify 26 native atoms with realistic states, complete contracts and usable screenshots at all three viewports

evidence: The assigned 26 atoms need 54 distinct states and 162 usable screenshots. Current Aside, Blockquote and Code display implementation names; long content, controls and disclosures use generic fixture copy. Native implementations remain forwarding primitives.
